description: Get one Bitcoin Rune by id or name. Returns null when not found or Runes is not configured. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted). Self-host needs the bitcoin compose profile.

rune.description: Rune id (840000:3) or name, any case, with or without spacers

name: index_rune
